systems.owner: Ministry of Health with ICAP at Columbia University; funded by PEPFAR through US CDC; code base transferred to local capacity in August 2025
systems.tiers: five sites since field testing began July 2024: Munuki Primary Health Care Centre (Juba), Al Sabah Children's Hospital, Rumbek State Hospital, Yirol Hospital and Yambio State Hospital, about 17 percent of the PEPFAR-supported ART caseload; records keyed by dedicated data entry teams, 12,700+ legacy records digitised

note: The only system described is a patient-level register for one programme (HIV treatment), which the typology classes as tracker although the source calls it an EMR; no fact for hmis or emr.
